name: L. N. Cary
role: Mandan man of the firm Carpenter & Cary; legislative candidate in 1884
bio: L. N. Cary of Mandan, of the firm of Carpenter & Cary, was the Cow Boy's favored candidate for the territorial legislature in the summer of 1884, endorsed in several issues. In June 1886 he returned from locating the site of the 1883 murder of Dode Straugh, to settle whether it had happened in Dakota or Montana.
